Unawareness and the over awareness of the youth. 10 years ago, the financial circumstances were better but the whole decision making was in the parents and the elder people’ hands.

Now the parents give more freedom to the youth. : Because of the changes in the society (television, satellites receiver, internet) the younger generation require more flexibility than their parents when they were young.
Education is necessary and important… but the educational level decreased drastically recently.

Because of the quality of the teaching and the hard financial situation of the parents which lead to school drop for young people and look for available opportunities of work at the family farm or/and as agricultural laborers.
The education is very important for young men; it helps improve the wellbeing level of their families.
(The population perceives their children education as an opportunities for poor families to quite precarious situation.)
Most young boys quit at high school grades for many reasons :

The high school is in other village so the parents are forced to provide housing for their children (renting an apartment, or a room near to the school), in most cases it’s beyond the parents capacity.

High school gathers huge number of students from various socio-economic backgrounds, which discourage young student coming from poor families because of the feel of inferiority (availability of school furniture, clothing, parents supports).

Also there is cases where the father forces his young boys to quit school and start working in the family farm, or as laborers to contribute to the household income (this concerns especially the elder children).

In general, it’s easy to pass during primary and middle school, till high school, that’s where exams are hard and passing is challenging (because of the bad quality of education in the). Which cause a lot of school drop.
Girls are predestinated to marriage (mostly in young age –from 15 years old-).

University studies are a big step for girls because they need to leave the house and move to the city where universities are. The parents (fathers) rarely agrees. ( if they have family in city where the girl will continue studying the father accepts, otherwise, he doesn’t want his girl to live alone.
Girls usually study better than the boys and their education are not limited to the high school.
“We have a lot of girls who graduated and who work”
A high school diploma allows you to reach universities or technician schools.
But mostly boys and girls in the village reach high school.

The parents may encourage their children to study, but it’s only financially speaking…on the other hand they don’t encourage them immaterially, like being there for them to follow up and supervise them.
The parents encourage both of boys and girls but girls usually study more seriously than boys and respect the commitment more with the school.
The youth don’t like to work in agriculture and don’t like agricultural activities
Boys in the village start work agricultural very young usually in the family or neighbor farm, the main jobs they do are:
Taking ruminants or cows to grazing land (mostly close to the village).
Supervising laborers (working in their father’s farm).
Participating in the daily farm tasks (family farms or as laborers in other farms): seeding (wheat, legumes, onions, potatoes..), weeding, fertilizing, harvesting (especially olives).

Reasons for ending education
• Lowness of educational level compared to the city students
• Lowness of social level (clothes, appearance…)
• Lowness of financial level
• The high-school is far, it’s in the city

Two most important reasons
• 1 – Lowness of educational level compared to the city students
• 2 – Lowness of social level (clothes, appearance…)
In general the goal is looking for a job or learning something to use later to make a living; a profession/ a trade.

The majority of young people go in the direction of enrolling into professional trainings that has nothing to do with agriculture… even when they know they won’t find jobs in this village according to what they studied and learned. The only way for them to find opportunities is to move to the city or look in industrial areas.
The young men who finished the high school have two choices :
Working in agriculture : in the fathers farm, or as laborers.
Completing their studies: moving to the city and enter to the technician schools.

Getting a professional training degree (technician schools: 2 years of study to have technician diploma) is the best option for the youth however there should be many choices in their orientation, things that respond to the young people’ needs like agriculture, mechanics and trade/commerce and things related to business.

Its importance is in the economy regarding the water use and also in the increase of the produces and expanding the surfaces of irrigated lands.
The decrease of daily working hours for agriculture laborers is a better thing for laborers… but for the farmer (owner) it’s an increase in the expanses:
Laborers used to work for non-defined working hours. But now (3 years since) all laborers agreed to work 7 hours a day. And if the farmers demand extension of this period, laborers require pay raise.

“Nowadays, all laborers leave the work at 2h p.m. they negotiate working hours at the ‘moquef’ before starting the job. They ask for 60 to 70 dhs for 7 hours of working, if the farmers want them to extra one hour they ask for 90 to 100 dhs”
New varieties of selected seeds; their importance is about the quality and quantity of the produces:
Improved seeds of soft wheat.

2012 : XX stated exploiting big farms of olives trees (those farms were under the authorities of National Companies (SOGEA, SOGETA) responsible of managing former farms of colonists (in this case they were Spanish farms).
Women are the main hired laborers to work in this farms (more than 70% of the hirers laborers are women) .
No, the farmer’s daughter usually doesn’t work in agriculture and has nothing to do with land except if the family experiences poverty and the need…
